events.text: Callie House (Harborlight) came through the crossing: +1 Influence for good, what was carried across.
Callie House (Harborlight) relocates from the Gates of The Middle Passage to the Gates of Jim Crow, still Ready.
Ayuba Suleiman Diallo (Silverlake Slayer) relocates from The Cotton Club to the Gates of Jim Crow and is Ready.

Bessie Coleman (Silverlake Slayer) cannot enter: no room Inside.
Oshun: Sojourner Truth gains +1 Influence permanently.
Richard Allen: calls the congregation, but nobody named is left in the deck.
William Still: looks at the top 2 cards of the deck, keeps Mary Seacole and puts the rest on the bottom.
William Still: looks at the top 2 cards of the deck, keeps one and puts the rest on the bottom.
Thaddeus Stevens: no Threat here to legislate against.
Edmonia Lewis: The Middle Passage gains +2 lasting Influence for Silverlake Slayer (a work that outlasts its maker). It stays even if Lewis leaves.
Madam C.J. Walker (Harborlight) enters Jim Crow.
Queen Nzinga (Silverlake Slayer) enters The Cotton Club.
Harriet Tubman (Silverlake Slayer) enters The Cotton Club.
Team-up, The Raid: John Brown and Harriet Tubman stand together Inside The Cotton Club. Your Characters here confront Threats with +2 Force. It holds while both remain.
The Middle Passage takes Bessie Coleman: they did not survive the crossing and leave the match.

data.note: The crossing's own odds: about one in seven did not survive it. Bessie Coleman goes to Silverlake Slayer's discard. Marie Laveau calls the last one lost back to the hand.
